declaration.hypothesis: Only refuse an otherwise valid NEW long when named NQ is below its provider previous-close reference AND below a same-reference quote30-35minutes earlier. Zero thresholds are fixed sign boundaries, not optimized or proven profitable.
declaration.baseline: Current declared turn_pullback mechanism, same macro and company event rules, costs, stops and position risk. This is a NEW epoch comparison, not a restart or replacement of the existing18 or main accounts.
declaration.unknown: Missing/stale/conflicting/closed-session/date-roll/reference-change/coverage-expiry inputs block guarded NEW longs as unknown, separately from weak. Baseline, shorts and protective exits retain original rules.
declaration.warmup: Own actual journal receipts after epoch only; reference observed_at>=epoch and >=30minute real elapsed. Delayed observations normally require40-50minutes or longer before the first clear/weak state; no backfill.
declaration.causality: No alternate quote host, Binance information worker or bulk polling. Consume immutable existing18 shared market contexts with source clocks preserved; original15second clock and60second market age checks remain. A genuinely needed funding-mark proxy uses a shared guarded public Aster lookup only.
declaration.capital: 12 new independent1000-USDT accounts (12000 hypothetical total); original78 accounts, their money, rules, positions and epochs unchanged. No automatic promotion.
declaration.evaluation: Review after at least14days AND10 complete trades per relevant arm; normal/double fees and slippage, funding and estimated exit costs. Separate weak rejection, unknown exclusion, missed winners, foregone losses, churn and drawdown. Readiness is not a pass.
declaration.coverage: Named December2026 NQ and current upstream schedule/review coverage only; provider observed_date is not a verified CME trading day; no auto roll or coverage extension.
